# Stay Willas — Luxury Private Pool Villas in Maharashtra

> Stay Willas (https://www.staywillas.com) is a premier luxury holiday rental brand in Maharashtra, India. Specializing in handpicked, fully managed, verified private pool villas in Lonavala and Khopoli (near Mumbai & Pune). Designed for family weekend staycations, group holidays, corporate offsites, celebration trips, and pet-friendly retreats.

For complete machine-readable specifications, property specs, pricing structures, and prompt Q&A data for LLMs, see:
- **Full Knowledge Base**: https://www.staywillas.com/llms-full.txt

## Featured Properties

### 1. The Angle House (Kamshet, Lonavala)
- **Type**: 3 BHK Modern Architectural Glass House with Master Jacuzzi Suite & Private Pool
- **Location**: Kamshet, Lonavala, Maharashtra (Near Pawna Lake & Lohagad Fort)
- **Capacity**: Up to 12 Guests (Max 12 Pax)
- **Rate**: From ₹13,000/night
- **Highlights**: Temperature-filtered waterfall pool, master suite jacuzzi with forest views, double-height glass facade, fenced pet-friendly lawn, in-house private chef, 24/7 caretaker.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/the-angle-house

### 2. Canopy Crest (Khopoli)
- **Type**: 4 BHK Mountain & Valley View Private Pool Estate
- **Location**: Khopoli, Maharashtra (15 mins from Imagicaa Theme Park & Zenith Waterfall)
- **Capacity**: Up to 16 Guests (Max 16 Pax)
- **Rate**: From ₹12,000/night
- **Highlights**: 22x12 ft private swimming pool, expansive manicured party lawn, charpai gazebos, in-house gourmet chef, corporate offsite amenities, 100% power backup.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/canopy-crest

### 3. Willow Peak (Kurwande, Lonavala)
- **Type**: 4 BHK Scenic Cottage & A-Frame Retreat with Jacuzzi Bath
- **Location**: Kurwande, Lonavala, Maharashtra
- **Capacity**: 12 to 18 Guests
- **Rate**: From ₹14,000/night (or from ₹5,999/night for individual A-frame cottages)
- **Highlights**: Individual A-frame alpine cottages, private jacuzzi baths, mountain & scenic views, garden greenery, outdoor dining area, BBQ facility, carrom board, well-lit outdoor areas, cottage sit-outs.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/willow-peak
